summary: Choose a small set of authored rules whose variations produce coherent families, with parameters that have observable roles.
objective: Changing one control changes the intended visual property; reset reproduces the documented starting composition when reproducibility is promised.
intent_signals: Expose meaningful controls for procedural variation
example_prompts: Create a generative grove where branch density and curvature are separate editable design controls.

principles: Choose a small set of authored rules whose variations produce coherent families, with parameters that have observable roles.
implementation: Generate repeated elements with controlled spacing, scale and orientation ranges; retain a stable seed or saved result when reproducibility is useful.
Map material or color variation to named design parameters rather than unstructured randomness; use light to reveal the resulting pattern.
Provide an overview and local inspection; parameter changes may animate only if element identity and state interpretation remain clear.

Seed a 32-bit PRNG (mulberry32) and persist the seed with the composition together with the three exposed parameters - count, spacing ratio 1.0-1.6 and jitter 0-0.3 - rather than the generated transforms, so reset reproduces the documented layout exactly.

Apply per-instance jitter of plus or minus 8 degrees yaw and plus or minus 12% scale through InstancedMesh.setMatrixAt; below about 5% the field reads as copy-paste and above about 20% the underlying rule stops being visible.
observable_checks: Changing one control changes the intended visual property; reset reproduces the documented starting composition when reproducibility is promised.

defaults.rationale: A generative image is only interesting when the viewer can separate the rule from the noise, so the numbers put the primary parameter on a single 25-70% saturation ramp with monotonic value and force every other parameter onto size or orientation. The 60-degree key with a 4:1 ratio lights every instance identically on purpose - variation must read as parameter, never as lighting - and the seeded PRNG with three exposed controls makes any composition reproducible from four numbers.

palette.role: seed marker and outliers outside the ramp

values.value_structure: 50/35/15 dark/mid/light; luminance follows the primary parameter so the image histogram mirrors the parameter histogram
values.saturation_rule: one ramp spanning 25-70% HSL along a single parameter; a second parameter must use size or orientation, never a second hue ramp

lights.ratio: key:fill ~ 4:1 from a high sun so every instance is lit identically and variation reads as parameter rather than as position

values.intensity_unit: three-intensity (lux-scaled for Directional/Hemisphere, candela for Point/Spot; tuned with the stated tone_mapping.exposure)

materials.notes: one InstancedMesh with per-instance colour and scale from the seeded generator; jitter rotation by plus or minus 8 degrees and scale by plus or minus 12% so clones never read as copies

values.signature_technique: one documented 32-bit seed driving exactly three exposed parameters (count, spacing ratio, jitter), so any composition is reproducible from four numbers
never: unseeded Math.random in an authored composition
a separate hue ramp per parameter
more than three controls hiding the rule

known_limits: Values are authored starting points tuned for ACESFilmic tone mapping at exposure 1.0; re-tune every intensity, fog density and bloom threshold if you change the tone mapping or exposure.
No renderer run for this record; values are authored starting points.
creative_affordances: Combine with geometric abstraction or natural-world themes; procedural appearance is not evidence of a biological or physical growth model.
